Description: Delegate real work to Copilot, such as creating or updating records or running actions in Business Central.
Instructions that guide Copilot and agents towards better outcomes, by describing how work should be done in Business Central and beyond.
GettingStartedSteps: Use a US, GB, or DE Business Central online early access preview sandbox on version 30.0.58740.0 or later with a Partner Sandbox license and evaluation data only.

Ensure your tenant has an eligible Microsoft 365 subscription, Microsoft Copilot is enabled in Business Central, and you have a Business Central Essentials or Premium license. A Microsoft Copilot license is not required, but is highly recommended.

To get started, go to the business skills page, and create your first skill. You can include specific instructions, provide tips, explain concepts, or even describe work that happens outside Business Central, such as reading a specific Word document from SharePoint, checking your inbox, generating a slide deck, or searching the web.
Once you've activated your skill, open the Copilot pane and ask Copilot to perform a task related to that skill. Copilot automatically finds and applies the instructions from matching skills.
Use Send feedback in the Chat menu or the thumbs-up or thumbs-down controls to share feedback.

To use business skills with custom agents, sign into a Sandbox environment, open the custom agent avatar on the top-right of your Business Central role center homepage, and fill in the information. In the agent configuration window, select the Use Business skills field to connect your agent to the same catalog of skills in Business Central.

FeatureName: Add subcontracting suggestions to an existing purchase order
Description: You can add new subcontracting worksheet suggestions to a compatible open purchase order for the same vendor, keeping related work on one order.
GettingStartedSteps: Use a company with the Premium experience and the Subcontracting extension installed and set up. Start with a released production order that has subcontracted work that still needs to be ordered.
Open the Subcontracting Worksheets page and choose the Calculate Subcontracts action. Filter for the relevant production order or operation, then choose OK.
Select a suggestion whose Action Message field is New. Choose the Assign purchase order action and select a compatible open purchase order for the same vendor.
Ensure Accept Action Message is selected for this suggestion. Choose the Carry Out Action Message action, then choose OK.
Open the purchase order you selected and verify the additional subcontracting operation line and its production order and operation links. Supporting component or comment lines can also be present.
